children: The company reported Rs 4,019 crore in power supply revenue for Q2 FY27, while EBITDA from power supply increased 51 per cent year on year

Adani Green Energy is focusing on manpower management, operating expenses and technology investments to improve operational efficiency and profitability, the company’s management said during its second-quarter FY27 earnings call on 21 October 2026.

Saurabh Shah, Chief Financial Officer, Adani Green Energy, said operating costs had not risen in proportion to the company’s business growth. He added that the company was managing manpower, operations and maintenance (O&M) and other expenses more carefully.The company is also investing in digitisation and technology to improve operational performance.

Ashish Khanna, Chief Executive Officer, Adani Green Energy, said investments in technology and improved operating practices were helping the company increase profitability from its existing operations.
Khanna added that the company had been working over the past few quarters to reduce operating costs and improve returns from its operations.

Adani Green Energy reported revenue from power supply of Rs 4,019 crore in the second quarter of FY27, marking a 45 per cent year-on-year increase.Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) from power supply rose 51 per cent to Rs 3,835 crore during the quarter.
